name: background-lights
title: Background Lights
description: A wide blurred conic gradient that sweeps blue into cyan and yellow near the bottom of the screen, giving a dark hero a soft coloured glow. It is a single non-interactive backdrop layer.
use: A dark hero or section needs a soft band of colour at the bottom to lift it without a heavy image.
avoid: It is a fixed conic gradient at 20% opacity, so on light backgrounds the glow barely shows and the colours cannot adapt.
a11y: It is a decorative empty layer with no roles; that is fine, but it carries no aria-hidden and nothing adapts for light themes. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-width, low band of soft colour along the bottom of a dark page: deep blue on the left shifting through teal to yellow on the right, blurred so no edges show. Above it sit a white headline, grey subtext and two buttons.
behaves: Static: the blurred glow sits still and never moves or responds; the demo simply fades it in once on load.
customise: Only className is accepted; the conic colours, blur radius and 20% opacity are hardcoded in the source, so a different palette means editing the file.
weight: light: One div painted with a blurred conic gradient; no script, no per-frame work.
demo: Headline Ship interfaces people trust, subtext about 4,200 teams, and Our work and Contact us buttons.
issues: At 20% opacity the glow is barely visible on the dark stage, so the effect reads as faint.
polishWhy: Soft, tasteful glow that lifts the hero; it is very faint and the palette is fixed.
